reader.requirement: At --std 85, when the OCCURS DEPENDING ON entry is in a record description entry that has the EXTERNAL clause (a Working-Storage 01), data-name-1 must possess the external attribute (it is in an EXTERNAL WS record, or in a record of an EXTERNAL FD, per §1985:II.6.2.2.2.3) AND must be described in the same Data Division as the table.

edition-consulted.switches: ClauseOperandsTakeImplicitQualifiers (DialectLevel >= 2002): at 85 the whole scope's candidates are counted
DialectLevel < 2002: a report SUM counter may be data-name-1

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|Construct in OdoResolvePass.cs#DependingAttributeFault and DataBinder.cs#IsInExternalRecord: neither reads the edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover the external-attribute half (EXTERNAL counter admitted, internal counter refused); the 'described in the same Data Division' half, a counter in an EXTERNAL FD record, and a counter inside the same external record are not exercised

probes.printed: error COBOL2788: ... the table's record 'E' is EXTERNAL and data-name-1 does not possess the external attribute
error COBOL2788 (counter in a record of a non-EXTERNAL FD)
probes.expected: refused: records of an internal FD are internal

probes.printed: EXIT 0, OK (counter in a record of an EXTERNAL FD)
probes.expected: admitted: those records attain the external attribute (§1985:II.6.2.2.2.3)
admitted (counter inside the same external record, before the table)

probes.printed: EXIT 0, XY| (the inner program's EXTERNAL table depends on the container's EXTERNAL GLOBAL NE)
probes.expected: refused: data-name-1 is not described in the same Data Division

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR8  (5.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR8
OK  §1985:II.6.2.2.2.3  (6.2.2.2.3 Record Areas for Files)  the text is in the clause
OK  §1985:X.4.6.4 GR2  (║4.6.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The external-attribute half holds. The 'described in the same Data Division' half is not enforced. OdoResolvePass's comment says it 'holds by construction' because the pass runs before a contained program inherits names. The probe shows that data-name-1 resolves to a container's GLOBAL item, and the program runs on the container's counter.
reader.at-2023: EXIT 0, XY| (accepted the same way; only an EXIT PROGRAM archaic warning)

reader.expected: A compile-time refusal: data-name-1 'must reference a data item possessing the external attribute which is described in the same Data Division' (§1985:VI.5.8.3 SR8); NE is described in the containing program's Data Division
